column1: # kext-local marker overlay (T6). The shared nextbsd-ci manifest (markers.tsv)
# is checked out at the pinned tag and loaded first; this overlay declares the
# display markers the kext image's booted guest must have, so the kext repo
# version-codes its own assertions without a nextbsd-ci tag bump.
# Per-arch display gate — IOKit picks each arch's NATIVE display kext from
# the devices the machine has, so the gate follows that split instead of
# forcing one kext on both arches:
#   BOCHS   amd64  fail-gates  amd64's display: the q35 machine's FIRST video
#           device is its boot VGA (vgapci0, unremovable — OVMF/efifb depend
#           on it), mapped by IOKit to BochsGraphics. A -FAIL (the display
#           kext did not come up) is a real graphics regression and fails the
#           boot; a bare absence does not gate.
#   VIRTIO  arm64  fail-gates  arm64's display: -M virt has no VGA, the only
#           video device is the virtio-gpu -> VirtIOGraphics. Same policy.
#   VGAP    amd64  warn        the amd64 virtio-gpu ADD-ON (a second device):
#           it does not attach until the amd64 kernel drives it (vgap gap,
#           nextbsd-ci#6). Reported, never gated; when the gap closes it
#           prints VGAP-OK and can be promoted to fail-gates.
# NOTE: the on-image suite emits ONLY its own arch's markers. The harness'
# marker arms are policy-driven (a fail-gates -FAIL exits 1 even off-arch),
# so arm64 never prints BOCHS/VGAP and amd64 never prints VIRTIO.
VIRTIO
column6: T6 GPU validation (arm64): the booted guest's display (virtio-gpu, the only video device on -M virt) must have VirtIOGraphics autoloaded; a -FAIL is a graphics regression.

column1: BOCHS
column6: T6 GPU validation (amd64): the booted guest's display (boot VGA vgapci0, q35's first video device) must have BochsGraphics autoloaded; a -FAIL is a graphics regression.

column1: VGAP
column6: T6 GPU validation (amd64, informational): the virtio-gpu add-on does not attach on amd64 (vgap gap, nextbsd-ci#6) until the amd64 kernel drives it; a -FAIL is reported, not gated.
